titulo: Voyager 1 is so far its messages take almost a day 🛰️
descripcion: Launched in 1977, Voyager 1 is the most distant human-made object. Its radio signals now need close to 23 hours to reach Earth.

escenas.texto: Voyager one left Earth in nineteen seventy seven, and it never stopped.
It is now more than twenty four billion kilometers away.
Its messages, moving at the speed of light, take almost a full day to reach us.
Its radio transmitter has about the power of a fridge light bulb.
It carries a golden record with sounds and music from Earth.

visual.sub: a message for anyone out there

escenas.texto: Our farthest messenger is still talking to us. Follow for more space facts.
